description: This file defines various loss function classes used in the PyTorch neural network modules, such as L1Loss, MSELoss, CrossEntropyLoss, NLLLoss, and others. It includes class definitions, imports, and documentation for loss calculation in neural network training.

classes.name: _Loss
classes.description: Base class for loss functions that handle reduction parameter

classes.name: _WeightedLoss
classes.description: Abstract class for weighted loss functions, extending _Loss, adds support for optional weights

classes.name: L1Loss
classes.description: Criterion class for mean absolute error loss

classes.name: NLLLoss
classes.description: Negative log likelihood loss for classification tasks

classes.name: NLLLoss2d
classes.description: Deprecated 2D version of NLLLoss, use NLLLoss

classes.name: PoissonNLLLoss
classes.description: Negative log likelihood loss under Poisson distribution assumptions

classes.name: GaussianNLLLoss
classes.description: Loss for modeling Gaussian negative log likelihood

classes.name: KLDivLoss
classes.description: Kullback-Leibler divergence loss for probabilistic models

classes.name: MSELoss
classes.description: Mean squared error loss criteria

classes.name: BCELoss
classes.description: Binary cross entropy loss criterion

classes.name: BCEWithLogitsLoss
classes.description: Combines a sigmoid layer and BCELoss for numerical stability

classes.name: HingeEmbeddingLoss
classes.description: Hinge embedding loss for measuring similarity/dissimilarity

classes.name: MultiLabelMarginLoss
classes.description: Multi-label hinge loss

classes.name: SmoothL1Loss
classes.description: Loss combining L1 and L2 behaviors, less sensitive to outliers

classes.name: HuberLoss
classes.description: Robust loss combining L1 and L2 characteristics, similar to SmoothL1Loss

classes.name: SoftMarginLoss
classes.description: Logistic loss for binary classification tasks

classes.name: CrossEntropyLoss
classes.description: Combination of LogSoftmax and NLLLoss for classification

classes.name: MultiLabelSoftMarginLoss
classes.description: Multi-label loss based on max-entropy and soft margins

classes.name: MultiLabelSoftMarginLoss
classes.description: Creates a criterion that optimizes a multi-label one-versus-all loss based on max-entropy.

classes.name: CosineEmbeddingLoss
classes.description: Creates a criterion that measures the loss based on cosine similarity or dissimilarity between input tensors.

classes.name: MarginRankingLoss
classes.description: Creates a criterion that measures ranking loss given input tensors and target labels indicating order.

classes.name: MultiMarginLoss
classes.description: Creates a criterion for multi-class classification hinge loss (margin-based loss).

classes.name: TripletMarginLoss
classes.description: Creates a criterion for triplet loss to measure relative similarity among anchor, positive, and negative samples.

classes.name: TripletMarginWithDistanceLoss
classes.description: Creates a criterion measuring triplet loss using a custom or built-in distance function on input tensors.

classes.name: CTCLoss
classes.description: The Connectionist Temporal Classification loss for sequence-to-sequence problems with unaligned input-output sequences.
